text.description_html:
Brass Accents A07-K5200, Solid Brass 6-1/2 Inch High Traditional Doctors Door Knocker

The Solid Brass Accents Traditional Doctors Door Knocker is ideal for adding elegance to any front door. At 6-1/2" high, this is the smaller version of the always popular Doctor's Door Knocker. Made by Brass Accents, it is hand finished in the USA. This brass door knocker is made with the distinctive craftsmanship and old-world tradition for which Brass Accents is known.

Click here for the larger 8 inch High Doctors Door Knocker

Specifications of the Traditional 6-1/2" Doctor's Door Knocker:

  • Finish: Polished Brass
  • Height: 6-1/2"
  • Width: 2"
  • Mounting Centers: 4-3/8"
  • Max Projection: 2-3/4"
  • Materiel: Solid Brass

No matter which finish you choose for the outside, it will still be solid brass material inside.

** This item is discontinued. See available Door Knockers.
